# The Things Stack for LoRaWAN Documentation

> Documentation for The Things Stack, the LoRaWAN® network server by The Things Industries: getting started, gateways, devices, integrations, API and deployment guides.

The Things Stack is an enterprise LoRaWAN® Network Server by The Things Industries. It is available as
The Things Stack Cloud (hosted), The Things Stack Enterprise (self-hosted), The Things Stack Sandbox
(formerly The Things Network) and The Things Stack Open Source. Current version: 3.37.0.

Every page is also available as Markdown: append `index.md` to the page URL, as in the links below.
The full text of all guides is in https://www.thethingsindustries.com/docs/llms-full.txt.

## Integrations

Integrations in The Things Stack are methods used to store, process and/or transfer application data to external end points. This section contains information …

- [Integrations](https://www.thethingsindustries.com/docs/integrations/index.md)
- [Adding Applications](https://www.thethingsindustries.com/docs/integrations/adding-applications/index.md): An Application in The Things Stack is a collection of end devices.
- [Data Formats](https://www.thethingsindustries.com/docs/integrations/data-formats/index.md): The Things Stack sends and receives application data from the various integrations in JSON format. This documentation provides some examples of these messages.
- [Payload Formatters](https://www.thethingsindustries.com/docs/integrations/payload-formatters/index.md): Payload formatters allow you to process data going to and from end devices. This is useful for converting binary payloads to human readable fields, or for doing …
  - [Creating Payload Formatters](https://www.thethingsindustries.com/docs/integrations/payload-formatters/create/index.md): This section explains how to set up Payload Formatters using the Console or CLI.
  - [CayenneLPP](https://www.thethingsindustries.com/docs/integrations/payload-formatters/cayenne/index.md): The Cayenne Low Power Payload (LPP) provides a convenient and easy way to send data over LPWAN networks such as LoRaWAN. The Cayenne LPP is compliant with the …
  - [Device Repository](https://www.thethingsindustries.com/docs/integrations/payload-formatters/device-repo/index.md): Device manufacturers may submit payload formatters designed to work with their devices. The data and code are publicly available in the Github Repository. You …
  - [JavaScript](https://www.thethingsindustries.com/docs/integrations/payload-formatters/javascript/index.md): JavaScript payload formatters allow you to write functions to encode or decode messages. JavaScript functions are executed using an JavaScript ECMAScript 5.1 …
- [Webhooks](https://www.thethingsindustries.com/docs/integrations/webhooks/index.md): The Webhooks feature allows The Things Stack to send application related messages to specific HTTP(S) endpoints.

## API

The Things Stack is API first by design and has rich support for various kinds of APIs. This section introduces the reader to the different types of APIs …

- [API](https://www.thethingsindustries.com/docs/api/index.md)
- [Concepts](https://www.thethingsindustries.com/docs/api/concepts/index.md): This guide introduces important concepts required to use The Things Stack APIs.
  - [Authentication](https://www.thethingsindustries.com/docs/api/concepts/auth/index.md): The Things Stack supports authentication using API keys, OAuth access tokens and Session cookies.
  - [Field masks](https://www.thethingsindustries.com/docs/api/concepts/fieldmasks/index.md): The Things Stack APIs use field masks (on supported APIs) to specify a subset of fields that should be returned by a reading request, or updated in a writing …
  - [Pagination](https://www.thethingsindustries.com/docs/api/concepts/pagination/index.md): The Things Stack supports pagination which is used to control the amount of data returned to the client for a request.
  - [Errors](https://www.thethingsindustries.com/docs/api/concepts/errors/index.md): The Things Stack APIs return rich errors and error codes to indicate failure of API requests.
  - [LoRa® Gateway specific APIs](https://www.thethingsindustries.com/docs/api/concepts/lora-gateway/index.md): The Things Stack supports multiple LoRa® gateway protocols which communicate the respective APIs.
  - [Troubleshooting](https://www.thethingsindustries.com/docs/api/concepts/troubleshooting/index.md): Troubleshooting API
